test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held On: 29 Jan 2022)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence. In case no improvement is needed, select 'No improvement required'.

Is this the __same book like__ our teacher recommended?
solution:
The correct answer is **'same book as'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• There is an error in **preposition usage** in the underlined part of the given sentence. 
 
• The **preposition like **is used to compare two things or to compare appearance or behaviour. 
 
 
• *Example - She’s got a headache **like **me./ That house looks **like **a castle.*
 
 
 
• ​But in the given case* *it is being implied that the book plays a substitute role in place of something else. 
 
• In such a case, we use the **preposition as **which means ‘in the role of’
 
• Thus, the underlined part will be improved by **option 1 **or **'same book as'.**

***Correct sentence - ****Is this the **same book as__** our teacher recommended?*
